args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The BASE_URL constant uses process.env.PUBLIC_URL falling back to localhost rather than reading from the application config object where production URLs are configured. Switch BASE_URL to use config.baseUrl so reset-password email links point to the correct domain in production.
args.title: Use config for BASE_URL in src/notifications/templates.ts
